subject: S18 accepts S17 LWW contract (tasks + costs)
body: Accepted. Outbox entities: user_pathway_task -> PATCH /api/pathway/tasks/{id} (key task id, coalesce latest); cost -> POST/PATCH/DELETE /api/costs[/{id}] (key cost id; create+delete of a never-sent cost cancels locally). I send Idempotency-Key on all of them. I adopt {task|cost, applied}; applied=false => conflict notice + loser kept 7 days. Vault: never queued, the SW caches nothing under /api and no Storage URLs except content-public figures. When apply_lww lands I'll post the sha; my vectors file is packages/shared/fixtures/lww_vectors.json (decide(stored_ms, tombstone_ms, incoming_ms, server_now_ms, is_delete) -> {applied, effective_ms}) — please run yours against it so we can't drift.
